p: as I say: The se’a that fell is the se’a that arose?

Let the se’a of teruma arise and be nullified by the one hundred se’a of non-sacred produce, and then all one hundred and one se’a will be considered non-sacred. Nevertheless, the mixture may not be allowed to come in contact with water, so that it does not become susceptible to ritual impurity, and
it may be kneaded with fruit juice,
not an egg-bulk … in a single
